module origen_168584 (
    input clk_i,
    input rst_n,
    input MemtoReg_i, MemRead_i, MemWrite_i, Branch_i, RegWrite_i, BranchType_i, RegDst_i, ALUSrc_i,
    input [3:0] ALUOP_i,
    input [31:0] program_suppose_i, readData1_i, readData2_i, instance_signExtend_i, instance_zeroFilled_i,
    input [31:0] instruction_i,
    output reg MemtoReg_o, MemRead_o, MemWrite_o, Branch_o, RegWrite_o, BranchType_o, RegDst_o, ALUSrc_o,
    output reg [3:0] ALUOP_o,

    output reg [31:0] instruction_o
);

    always @(posedge clk_i) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            MemtoReg_o <= 1'b0;
            MemRead_o <= 1'b0;
            MemWrite_o <= 1'b0;
            Branch_o <= 1'b0;
            RegWrite_o <= 1'b0;
            BranchType_o <= 1'b0;
            RegDst_o <= 1'b0;
            ALUSrc_o <= 1'b0;
            ALUOP_o <= 4'b0000;
            program_suppose_o <= 32'b0;
            readData1_o <= 32'b0;
            readData2_o <= 32'b0;
            instance_signExtend_o <= 32'b0;
            instance_zeroFilled_o <= 32'b0;
            instruction_o <= 32'b0;
        end else begin
            MemtoReg_o <= MemtoReg_i;
            MemRead_o <= MemRead_i;
            MemWrite_o <= MemWrite_i;
            Branch_o <= Branch_i;
            RegWrite_o <= RegWrite_i;
            BranchType_o <= BranchType_i;
            RegDst_o <= RegDst_i;
            ALUSrc_o <= ALUSrc_i;
            ALUOP_o <= ALUOP_i;
            program_suppose_o <= program_suppose_i;
            readData1_o <= readData1_i;
            readData2_o <= readData2_i;
            instance_signExtend_o <= instance_signExtend_i;
            instance_zeroFilled_o <= instance_zeroFilled_i;
            instruction_o <= instruction_i;
        end
    end

endmodule

The input/output and stage panels below describe the task; the evaluation runner’s saved prompt and visible-file manifest identify the actual entry point. A case manifest or private reference file is not an agent starting instruction.

A stored instruction is distinct from the runtime launch message, which can add framing and execution limits. The agent uses the harness’s file-reading tools to inspect available inputs.
